verdict.rationale: Vercel AI Gateway is a model-routing and proxy layer. It handles provider routing, failover, budgets, BYOK and observability, so user-defined background automations fall outside what this kind of product does. Its agent-related evidence, the ToolLoopAgent example and the coding-agent setup, shows agents calling the gateway, not the gateway scheduling or running autonomous jobs itself. Its built-in automatic retries and failover are internal request handling, not user-configurable automations.
